profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Custom Stickers
profile.geoLocationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
profile.summary: I am a software engineer experienced in building full-stack web and mobile applications. I specialize in NodeJS with my most common stacks being NextJS, NestJS, and React Native.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: TypeScript · React.js · tRPC · PostgreSQL · Go (Programming Language) · Next.js

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
- Took lead as head developer in a NestJS cash-back rewards system that incentivized 30k+ users to join the waitlist.
- Created an internal responsive & auto-updating API doc website for numerous of our microservices written in GoLang. Significantly reduced vital time wasted by our team.
- In a scrum environment, worked alongside product, design, and QA to regularly ship and modify features in our React Native fintech mobile app.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Clojure · React Native · PostgreSQL · Go (Programming Language) · NestJS

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Created a WebSocket system allowing updates across all users to seamlessly rerender changes in the front end.
- Taught occasional lessons on TypeScript and Documentation standards to the team to improve the CRM chat bot service.
- Worked collaboratively with design and product to deliver a B2B SaaS web application in React with numerous microservices in Python and Golang.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · TypeScript · Chatbot Development · SAS (Software) · React.js · PostgreSQL · Go (Programming Language)

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
- Contracted directly under the company owner to deliver a leadership analysis tool from the ground up written in Angular with RXJS and Express.js.
- Managed traffic, bugs, and product management to cater the product used to teach in schools and companies.

positions.title: Back End Developer
positions.description: Customized UI and UX in Angular. Tailored project with conditional designs based on user interaction. Built PDFs and email templates for easy and simple use.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description: Designed and developed an online software with high-traffic use by universities and in large conferences allowing users to gain insights and detailed analytics on their performance. Built with a RESTful backend using Expressjs, routing with NGINX, and served with Angular. Also built custom SVGs, graphs, email templates, and PDFs.
